manifest.author: Yoshiki Tamura
manifest.description: DSH session-title provider that titles from all human messages (not just the first), plus idle retitling: sessions idle past a threshold get one refresh() so their title catches up with the conversation. Replaces the stock first-prompt provider.
manifest.name: dsh-session-title-idle-refresh

bundle.text:
# dsh-session-title-idle-refresh bundle patch.
#
# Inserting this provider REPLACES the stock first-prompt provider:
# only one session-title provider may be registered, so the stock
# row is disabled here (the same pattern the official session-titles
# bundle uses to swap in the all-prompts provider).
- id: session-title-llm
  disabled: true

- insert:
    - id: session-title-idle-refresh
      name: dsh-session-title-idle-refresh
      config:
        idleMs: 1800000
        scanMs: 60000
        minMessages: 2
        maxPerScan: 3
        targetWords: 5
        targetCjkCharacters: 10
        maxInputBytes: 16384
        maxOutputTokens: 4096
        timeoutMs: 60000

readme.text:
- Registers the session-title provider with `automatic: "first-prompt"` —
  the initial title is generated exactly once, as with the stock
  provider — but generation reads **all** human messages (stock
  all-prompts policy, including its keep-an-adequate-title stability
  rules, with the input trimmed to the byte budget).
- A timer scans live sessions every `scanMs`. A session is refreshed
  once via `ctx.sessionTitle.refresh()` when **all** hold:
  - its title does not yet cover the latest human message,
  - the last event and the last human message are older than `idleMs`
    (default 30 min),
  - it has at least `minMessages` human messages (default 2),
  - it is not a subagent child session,
  - its title is not user-pinned (rename).
  Attempts per uncovered tail are recorded in memory; a refresh is
  never retried for the same tail before `max(idleMs, 30min)` passes.

```

The package ships a bundle patch (`cordis.patch.yml`) that inserts
the provider row with the defaults below and disables the stock
`session-title-llm` row — only one title provider may be registered,yaml
- id: session-title-idle-refresh
  config:
    idleMs: 1800000
    scanMs: 60000
```

idleMs 1800000 · scanMs 60000 · minMessages 2 · maxPerScan 3 ·
targetWords 5 · targetCjkCharacters 10 · maxInputBytes 16384 ·
maxOutputTokens 4096 · timeoutMs 60000. No provider/model is pinned:
titles use each session's own logged route, like the stock provider.

An in-tree version of this behavior (a third automatic mode,
idle, for the session-title service) was prototyped against
deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness and is kept here as
upstream-idle-mode.patch. It is shelved for now: the upstream
repository does not accept external PRs, and the maintainer
prefers the plugin form.
